# @stackline/pg-types

`@stackline/pg-types@1.0.0` is an independent, dependency-free continuation of
`pg-types@2.2.0`. It preserves the CommonJS parser API, built-in PostgreSQL OID
map, published `lib/*` entry points, valid-value parser results, Node.js 4
support, and TypeScript 3.9 declarations. Explicit ESM exports are additive.

- Direct install: `npm install @stackline/pg-types@1.0.0`
- Historical-key alias: `npm install pg-types@npm:@stackline/pg-types@1.0.0`
- Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/pg-types
- Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-pg-types
- README: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/README.md
- Compatibility: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/COMPATIBILITY.md
- Migration: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/MIGRATION.md
- Dependency review: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/DEPENDENCY_REVIEW.md
- Security: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/SECURITY.md
- Full machine reference: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/pg-types/llms-full.txt

The installed production graph contains only the package root and has zero runtime dependencies. Exact compatible source from `pg-int8@1.0.1`, `postgres-array@2.0.0`,
`postgres-bytea@1.0.1`, `postgres-date@1.0.7`, and
`postgres-interval@1.2.0` is maintained in-tree with complete notices. Archived
`xtend@4.0.2` is not installed. Dangerous parser-map keys are isolated, and
malformed timestamp scanning is bounded without changing valid PostgreSQL
output.
